raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted an oscars.org archive page about the Maysles Collection that described Albert Maysles as an “Oscar-nominated filmmaker” and listed “Gimme Shelter” among his works, incorrectly inferring that Gimme Shelter itself was Oscar-nominated. This over-reliance on a vague snippet and failure to verify through the official Oscars database led to a false claim (even citing the wrong ceremony year), whereas the nomination actually applies to LaLee’s Kin (Best Documentary Feature, 2002).
